async function smelt3RawIronIntoIronIngotsTask(bot) {
    // This process aims to produce three iron ingots if the current count is less than that amount. It first checks if enough raw iron is available to meet the target. If a furnace is not nearby, it attempts to place one. Then, it selects an appropriate fuel source based on the required number of smelts. Finally, it initiates the smelting of the raw iron using the chosen fuel.
